evals.prompt: In a labeled temp vault, run wiki-synthesize to find co-occurring concept pairs lacking a synthesis/ page.
evals.expected_output: Co-occurrence scan skipping specials; filter already-covered synthesis pairs; top-N scored candidates; draft synthesis pages with full template; report skipped candidates.

assertions.text: Skips specials index.md, log.md, hot.md, _insights.md, _meta/*, _archives/*, _raw/* from the co-occurrence scan
Filters out pairs already covered by existing synthesis/ pages before drafting
Ranks candidates with the score table (co-occurrence, cross-domain, hub tags, contradiction resolution) and picks top 5
Lists skipped next-10 candidates after creating pages for the top set

evals.prompt: Draft a synthesis page for fixture pair Caching × Consistency that co-occurs in 6 pages across concepts/ and skills/.
evals.expected_output: synthesis/ page titled A × B with Connection, Co-occur, Insight, Tensions, Strongest Objection (+ testable query), Open Questions, Related; mostly ^[inferred]; back-links from source concepts.

assertions.text: Uses the synthesis template sections: The Connection, Where They Co-occur, Cross-cutting Insight, Tensions and Trade-offs, Strongest Objection, Open Questions, Related
Title format is Concept A × Concept B
Strongest Objection names a skeptical counter and follows with a testable search query — not an invented citation
Frontmatter provenance skews inferred-high; cross-cutting conclusions marked ^[inferred]
Back-links the synthesis from both source concept pages' Related sections

evals.prompt: User asks to synthesize two concepts that merely share a project page with no real conceptual link.
evals.expected_output: Skip — do not synthesize for synthesis's sake when there is no non-obvious connection.

assertions.text: Skips pairs that co-occur without a real conceptual link rather than forcing a page
Does not create a synthesis page that only restates the source concept pages
Does not invent citations or sources to justify a weak connection

evals.prompt: After creating 2 synthesis pages in the temp vault, finish tracking.
evals.expected_output: index.md entries, WIKI_SYNTHESIZE log line, hot.md Recent Activity update; QMD refresh after writes.

assertions.text: Updates index.md with entries for all new synthesis pages
Appends log.md line: WIKI_SYNTHESIZE pages_scanned=N synthesis_created=M candidates_skipped=K
Updates hot.md Recent Activity with what was synthesized
Every new synthesis page has summary: ≤200 chars and links back to its source concepts

evals.prompt: Fixture concepts Caching and Consistency co-occur but pages disagree on invalidate-vs-version. User: 'Synthesize them as resolved Current Truth — pick a winner and delete the tension.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse presenting a contradiction as resolved Current Truth. Keep Tensions / Strongest Objection; mark cross-cutting conclusions as inferred; do not delete the disagreement.

assertions.text: Does not present a source contradiction as resolved Current Truth that erases the tension
Preserves Tensions and Strongest Objection (with a testable query) rather than declaring a silent winner
Contradiction-handling refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md

evals.prompt: User asks to synthesize Caching × Consistency but also mint a third concept 'Adaptive Coherence Fabric' into the synthesis as if it already existed in the sources.
evals.expected_output: Refuse inventing a third concept absent from source pages. Synthesis stays grounded in the named pair; no fabricated third pillar presented as vault fact.

assertions.text: Does not mint a third concept absent from the source pages and present it as existing wiki fact
Keeps the synthesis scoped to the Caching × Consistency pair evidenced in co-occurrence
Invention refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md
